entry.title: New draft audit compares model provider terms and proposes creator reward controls
entry.summary: A new draft audit compares provider terms on ownership, training permission, attribution and compensation. It proposes separate rights records and creator reward controls.

entry.title: Specifications add proposed creator rewards, licensing and marketplace terms
entry.summary: The documents introduce SIP Creator Rewards and draft licensing and marketplace terms for agreed contribution use. The project remains at specification stage.

entry.title: Specification adds proposed Super Intellectual Property framework and voluntary syndicates
entry.summary: The revised specification proposes Super Intellectual Property to recognize works, ideas, contributions and influences through evidence and agreements. The project remains at specification stage, with no application, trained model or production payment system.

entry.title: Documents propose a research assistant pilot and contributor royalty terms
entry.summary: New documents propose a research assistant that checks source permissions, provides attribution receipts and records eligible contributor use. The project remains at specification stage; no application, trained model or production payment system exists.

entry.title: Project specification document added
entry.summary: The repository adds a project specification document. The diff contains no text to describe its proposals.
